comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs disclose net gains/losses specifically related to loans. JPMorgan reported net gains on sales of loans of $113 million for the year ended December 31, 2024. Goldman Sachs reported net realized and unrealized gains on Level 3 loans of $33 million for the same period (with total net losses on Level 3 loans of $8 million due to offsetting unrealized losses).

sentences.text: Net gains/(losses) on sales of loans and lending-related commitments (including adjustments to record loans and lending-related commitments held-for-sale at the lower of cost or fair value) recognized in noninterest revenue were $154 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, of which $113 million were related to loans.

The net realized and unrealized losses on level 3 loans of $8 million (reflecting $33 million of net realized gains and $41 million of net unrealized losses) for 2024 included gains/(losses) of $(13) million reported in other principal transactions and $5 million reported in interest income.
